scope: Private locator-initializer source reference in the current separate-browser native renderer-reuse composition. Same-browser and same-driver cache off/on comparison, plus stock-browser Playwright reference. No public default changed.

initial.scope: Private code-only locator initializer cache on the same V8 isolate. Exact source equality, one bounded unbound-script entry, fresh original execution context each run; existing context lookup, timeout, microtasks and post-execution scope validation remain.
initial.hypothesis: Retaining context-independent initializer code avoids compilation/cache eviction across document retirement; no JS objects or application state reused.
initial.gate: Before timing, fresh-context state/closures and ordinary assertions/navigation/input/media must pass. Compare same native and driver binaries cache off/on. Advance only if at least 10% complete setup/navigation/assertion reduction at one and four workers in both orders, no more than 5% regression in either real application. Final 2x confidence gate unchanged.
initial.limits: Private environment gate, exact object-group marker, non-REPL ordinary eval mode, no command-line API, source limited to 512K UTF-16 code units and fixed initializer prefix.
initial.audit: Optional native hit/miss receipts in separate controls; disabled for timings.

refined.hypothesis: Most 6.6ms injection-call time is outside the ~0.6ms native V8 conversion/compilation/execution interval. Avoid retransmitting a 373712-byte initializer across browser/renderer protocol boundaries.
refined.design: One bounded source string entry per inspector/isolate. Rust SHA256 content identity; exact same-key source conflict rejection. Reference miss returns false and Rust transmits full source. Hits use unchanged debug::EvaluateGlobal in original context/scope/timeout/microtask flow. No cached JS handles.
refined.identityTrust: Caller-supplied content identity from trusted local CDP client, derived by actual Rust SHA256. No security claim for hostile clients with full debugger access.
refined.gate: Same 10% complete setup/navigation/assertion reduction and <=5% application regression gate as initial plan; all semantic controls before timings.
refined.priorCandidate: Unbound-script retention rejected at diagnostic feasibility: 14 native hits per 15 contexts without a first-assertion gain.

policy.clock: Original watchdog owner, includes runner/browser/application-server startup, original callbacks, fresh contexts and natural drain. Static fixtures prebuilt for all arms.

limitations: One functional capture per cell, not comparative performance acceptance.

applications.scope: Complete original passing corpus, generated source identities, original test outcomes, request contract and observed cleanup. No general runner equivalence.

summary.earlierBuildControls: The preceding source-reference build passed the same matrix; it was rerun after removing unnecessary source copying from the cache-disabled path.

boundaryAttribution.scope: Two 15-context diagnostic library runs, selected Connection.call boundaries only. Nested elapsed intervals, not CPU decomposition, complete command coverage or removable savings.

source.scope: Diagnostic selected Connection.call enqueue/reply boundaries. Includes instrumentation overhead; not performance comparison. No parameter values or user source logged.

diagnosticPhases.scope: One cache-off/on launch for each candidate, 15 fresh contexts each, one extra repeated assertion per context. Warm medians exclude the first context. These are not original runner or complete-suite ratios.

implementation.cacheContents: One key and bounded UTF-16 source string per inspector/isolate; no cached JS handles. Original debug::EvaluateGlobal context, timeout, exception and microtask flow retained. Hit source copied into request-local storage for reentrancy.
implementation.identity: Actual Rust SHA-256 of full UTF-8 initializer. Native validates marker/64 lowercase hex and rejects conflicting same-key full source; it does not recompute the digest. Trusted local debugger client scope.
implementation.miss: False result triggers full-source fallback in the original unique context and operation deadline.
implementation.unboundScriptCandidate: Rejected at diagnostic feasibility: 14 hits without a first-assertion improvement. Its public Script::Run path also differed from the original debugger embedder-callback behavior; source-reference refinement retained EvaluateGlobal.

restoration.driverRestoration: The source-restored Rust build succeeded but differed from the known baseline executable. Explicitly restored the preserved known baseline binary after recording the rebuilt digest. No claim of byte-identical Rust rebuild.

retainedFailedPreparations: The first code-cache realm control expected executionContextId in exceptionDetails; the baseline omitted it. The corrected test invokes the original exception object to verify its actual realm. Both original failed attempts remain outside timing.
limitations: Fails the predeclared 10% complete reduction in all three targeted families, both worker counts and both orders, and the 5% application regression bound. No unchanged larger campaign or public adoption justified.
One four-worker SVGOMG source-cache observation regresses 28.15%; its cause is not established and it remains in the complete screen.
Two reversed pairs are not eight-pair confidence acceptance; no majority-scenario or required two-application win.
Selected controls do not prove exhaustive lifecycle correctness, hardware-decoder first-use behavior, full resource custody, clean full rebuild, other-platform compatibility or release readiness.
Original fixture source and actual report/request verification do not establish exhaustive native callback custody.
The failed compilation-retention result does not imply every form of compilation caching is useless; the source-reference gain does not isolate every protocol stage.
